description: OSM-Daten unterwegs Trinkwasser auffüllen NRW is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Kreis Viersen. Locations where drinking water can be replenished on the way in NRW based on OpenStreetMap. All objects are selected with water=refill, amenity=drinking water or drinking water:refill=yes. The service is updated every night. Source of OSM data:. Coverage: North Rhine-Westphalia (NRW). The portal shows the English title as "OSM data on the way to replenish drinking water NRW" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Kreis Viersen. Its keywords include Rösrath, Bad Oeynhausen, Mechernich, Lichtenau, Wenden, Aachen. The listing shows 6 download or service links in WFS, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
